entries.title: Short Pullback Continuation Directional Asymmetry and Historical Portability Study — period-role corrected continuation
entries.causal_hypothesis: Downtrend pullback continuation has a directionally asymmetric delayed right-tail payoff in the 2023-2024 Research period, but it is eligible for freeze only if the edge is sufficiently diffuse, resampling-stable, execution-robust and portfolio-risk non-worse before any 2025 access.
pre_result_predictions: Short-only net remains positive with PF at least 1.10 and all four half-year folds positive.
Net remains positive after best, top-3, top-5 and top winner-decile removal.
Event, date and session-block bootstrap lower 95 percent bounds are positive with P(non-positive) at most 5 percent.
Observed Bid/Ask edge remains positive after fixed spread, delay and slippage stress.
Adding the candidate improves net without worsening realized DD, full-equity DD, minimum equity, 5-day, 20-day or monthly loss clusters.
retained_findings: Short-only Pullback Continuation was positive in all four 2023-2024 half-year folds with PF 1.2728.
The edge remained positive under +2 pip spread, +15 second Entry delay and 0.5 pip adverse slippage per execution.
Adding Short Pullback improved net, realized DD, full-equity DD, minimum equity, worst 20-day loss and worst month.
The edge depended materially on the strongest winner decile and did not produce positive bootstrap lower bounds.
falsified_or_unsupported_claims: The Short edge is sufficiently diffuse to remain profitable after removing the strongest winner decile.
The expected net has a positive lower 95 percent bound under event, date or session-block resampling.
The candidate improves every preregistered portfolio loss-cluster metric.
The fixed candidate qualifies for freeze, Core/MT4 implementation or 2025 external validation.
prohibited_reuse: Do not reopen HYP-037 by relaxing concentration or bootstrap gates.
Do not remove winner events, sessions, months, 2024H2 or any side-defined subgroup.
Do not access 2025 for C1 because candidate freeze was not authorized.
Do not retune EMA, ATR, threshold, tolerance, hold, Entry, Exit or lot.
Do not reinterpret the v1 technical-no-result as the final scientific decision; preserve both records with v2 superseding period role only.
successor_questions: Which independently defined mechanism can complement B02/F05 without relying on rare right-tail winners or worsening short-horizon loss clusters?
entries.decision_note: Protocol corrected before protected-period access. HYP-037 closed at the first 2023-2024 Research binding failure. Core, MT4 and 2025 were not reached.
